text:
Anna L.: compiling a single view of audit-event coverage gaps across services (api-gateway, auth, console, billing, runtime). want to triage into sprint planning tomorrow.

Mike C.: thanks. do we have a spreadsheet or tracker already?

Anna L.: yep added a quick sheet -> https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/EXAMPLE
- cols: service, missing_event_types, affected_endpoints, risk, suggested_owner
- filled api-gateway & auth with initial findings

Sarah P.: quick note: customers care about 3 things: who, when, what changed. any event missing one of those is a blocker for customer-facing audits.

Jordan K.: ping @Mike C. for runtime gaps — I saw missing KV-cache eviction events for pinned models and some token-usage events.

Mike C.: got it. i'll take runtime + api-gateway logging hooks. can you add exact endpoints in the sheet? i want sample curl logs to reproduce.

Anna L.: added example lines in sheet. also we need a schema bump proposal. thinking events.schema.v2 with explicit fields for actor.id, actor.type, target.id, action, outcome, request_id, kms_key_id.

Anna L.: proposal snippet:
```
{
  "schema": "events.schema.v2",
  "timestamp": "2025-03-18T15:14:22Z",
  "actor": {"id":"user_123","type":"user"},
  "action": "update_role",
  "target": {"id":"project_45","type":"project"},
  "outcome": "success",
  "context": {"ip":"1.2.3.4","request_id":"r_abc"},
  "kms": {"key_id":"proj_kms_01","operation":"encrypt"}
}
```

Mike C.: +1 to explicit kms.key_id. ensure sensitive fields are redacted before customer download (no raw payloads with secrets).

Sarah P.: also need a customer-facing validation checklist for audit events:
- event contains actor, action, outcome, request_id
- timestamps in iso8601
- no PII in top-level fields
- kms key id present when encryption ops
- retention flagged per tenant-policy

Anna L.: can someone own the checklist doc and an automated test harness? i'd like a daily smoke that validates a sample prompt sequence produces the expected audit events.

Jordan K.: i can wire a simple test harness into our CI that runs against dev env. will need mappings for event types -> sample flows. adding to the sheet.

Mike C.: triage plan for tomorrow's grooming:
1) Critical: auth login/logout, role changes, token create/revoke (owner: @Sarah P.)
2) High: api-gateway route create/delete, runtime kv-evict, model-pin/unpin (owner: @Mike C.)
3) Medium: console UI changes (owner: @Anna L.)
4) Low: billing export events (owner: finance eng)

Anna L.: tagging ops-bot for deploy tracking. @ops-bot please create a rollout checklist for the schema migration and a canary plan.

ops-bot: created ticket INC-2025-137 in infra backlog; will post deploy checklist link into this thread when ready.

Sarah P.: callout on KMS BYOK flows — emit kms.key_origin: BYOK and validate key fingerprint as part of acceptance.

Mike C.: noted. also need a DB migration for event schema index on request_id and timestamp for query perf.

Anna L.: action items summary:
- Sarah P. owns auth critical events + customer validation checklist
- Mike C. owns runtime + api-gateway + DB index
- Jordan K. owns CI harness + sample flows
- Anna L. owns console events + schema PR
- ops-bot will provide deploy checklist/ticket

Mike C.: i'll create PRs for logging middleware and example payloads. aiming for draft by EOD today.

Anna L.: thanks all. we'll review in grooming 10am PST tomorrow. please update the sheet before EOD.
